The art of
presence.

Eternaluxe is a New York floral house composing botanical work for extraordinary spaces.

Its creative language is shaped by proportion, line and the relationship between an arrangement and its surroundings.

Drawing inspiration from ikebana, every composition considers the gesture of a branch, the quiet between stems and the architecture it inhabits.

From individual arrangements to private botanical commissions, each direction begins with the space and the feeling it should leave behind.
